question: Which divine inhabitants are found above the person in necessity and in time?
premises: Above the person, in the principle of necessity, there are ten golden-lustrous Shankaras.
In the principle of time there are ten very white Shivas.
The verse distinguishes the two levels by location and appearance.
inference: The levels above the person are populated by ten Shankaras in necessity and ten Shivas in time, each with a distinct appearance.
plain_english: Above the person, in the principle of necessity, there are ten golden-lustrous Shankaras. In the principle of time, there are ten very white Shivas.
